displayAddress: 6/4 King's Stables Road, Old Town, Edinburgh, EH1 2JY
description:
Set within the historic charm of Old Town, this exceptional first-floor, two-bedroom flat at 6/4 King's Stables Road offers a rare opportunity to enjoy elegant Georgian-inspired living with uninterrupted views of Edinburgh Castle.

Beautifully styled to blend classic period character with contemporary design, the property features a generous open-plan kitchen, dining, and living space defined by tall ceilings, large sash windows, and a striking central fireplace, creating a bright and sophisticated setting ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The interiors reflect a refined British heritage aesthetic, with carefully curated details throughout. One of the bedrooms is currently arranged as a study or home office, enriched with antique furnishings that enhance its timeless, Georgian influence. The master bedroom continues this seamless fusion of period and modern style, presenting a boutique, hotel-like ambience complete with a floor-to-ceiling wardrobe. A sleek, modern bathroom finished in dark marble-effect designer panels delivers a luxurious, spa-inspired feel, while a separate utility room adds practicality. 

The property further benefits from excellent transport links, making it an ideal base for city living while immersed in one of Edinburgh's most iconic and historic locations.

This distinctive home is likely to appeal to professionals, creatives, or those seeking a refined city residence with character, as well as buyers looking for a stylish pied-à-terre in the heart of Edinburgh. It may also attract investors interested in a premium property in a highly sought-after, historic setting, where strong demand and iconic views combine to create a truly compelling offering.
